newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goodyear, Bridgestone, Cooper in rubber inquiries.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear, Bridgestone, Cooper in rubber inquiries.

text.p: Goodyear Tire, Bridgestone and Cooper Tires are said to have made some inquiries on Thursday about SIR20 rubber, but no deals were concluded, dealers said.
"I heard Goodyear, Cooper and Bridgestone were looking for some forward supplies of SIR20 rubber," a dealer said.
"I don't think any deals have been done," another dealer said. Prices quoted were between 50 and 52 U.S. cents a kg.
All three companies were looking for forward supplies of SIR20 tyre-grade rubber. "For my money, the months they were looking at were October/December," a European dealer said.
Traders said conditions in the local exchange were subdued ahead of Easter. "The consumers are in the drivers' seat and can really dictate prices," one said.
The market will be closed on Friday and reopen on Monday.
"It'll be quiet tomorrow due to the holiday," one said.
At around 0945 GMT, May RSS3 was seen at 120.00 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 121.00 cents.
May RSS1 was seen at 173.00-175.00 Singapore cents (US$1.20-$1.21) a kg from 175.00 cents. October/December TSR20 was seen at 118.00 U.S. cents a kg against the previous 118.50 cents.
